    Finite pieces of the universal cover as covering data #

    For a finite ray category P and a finite set S of objects of its universal cover, the irreducible morphisms of the cover between objects of S form a finite quiver D_S, the projection gives a locally injective morphism of quivers D_S → Q_P, and the deck action of Π(P, x₀) makes this covering data in the sense of Definition 3.5 of the paper (RayCat.coverPieceData), given that Π(P, x₀) is torsion-free (it is free by Bongartz's Theorem 2).
